plan: DOCTRINE UPDATE, NOT A CONTRADICTION. The 2026-07-16 court's fv_base 159 was struck BEFORE the FQ3 print; re-based on the new audited quarter to fv_base 145 (bear 115->110, bull 215->195). (3) LIVE SHORT PUTS re-tested against e_fv 142.75 under the accumulation-basis conversion ruling: Sep-18 135p (basis 129.71, -9.1% vs e_fv) HOLD kill-linked; Sep-18 140p (basis 133.06, -6.8%) HOLD kill-linked; Aug-28 145p (basis 140.12, -1.8%) FLAG TO PRINCIPAL - it was struck 07-30, one day AFTER the print that cut FV by $14, and now converts at essentially fair value rather than below it. edge_explainer: Neither de-rate nor derailment: an AI-narrative round-trip (124 on Apr-07 -> 260 on May-29 -> 152 now) with a real operating leak underneath. The screen's '-41% from 3y high' measures from the top of a two-month narrative spike, not from a franchise multiple. FQ3 10-Q: revenue -4.0%, gross margin -250bps to 53.1%, R&D +17.1% (+$381M), SG&A +26.6% (+$205M) -> operating income -41.1%. FIFTY-EIGHT PERCENT OF THE COLLAPSE IS OPEX GROWTH ON FALLING REVENUE. Segment note shows where it goes: QCT EBT -18%, QTL EBT -6%, but the nonreportable (datacenter/AI) segment ran $165M revenue against -$214M EBT vs -$10M, and unallocated R&D/SG&A added -$301M - a -$605M YoY corporate drag. The reported '+2% segment EBT' is carried ENTIRELY by QSI investment marks (+$768M vs +$149M); strip them and core QCT+QTL EBT is -15%. TWO EARNINGS-QUALITY FLAGS: the nine-month tax line is a +$4,136M BENEFIT vs -$1,034M expense, so 9M GAAP EPS of $11.63 is roughly half a one-off; and $726M of securities marks sit inside FQ3 net income (~$0.56/sh), making core EPS ex-marks ~$1.31 against a reported $1.87. DATA TRAP LOGGED: yfinance forwardEps 10.30 / forwardPE 14.72 is STALE by one print - Street FQ4 consensus is $2.19, so ~$8.76 annualized = 17.4x, not 14.7x, and the screen inherited the stale figure. AI-BREAK p=0.45 conflict, stated not averaged: the entry does NOT require the cycle holding (the ~$800M/qtr of AI spend is cuttable and worth ~$2.38/sh after tax, a genuine cushion ORCL-type names lack), but the de-rate only PARTIALLY prices the break - at 17.4x forward on revenue -4% and core EBT -15% the price still embeds a stabilisation the FQ4 guide does not support. Household AI-complex exposure is already ~$5.2M/26%. TOP UNVERIFIABLE: the exact FQ4 guidance range was never read from primary - the 8-K incorporates Ex-99.1 by reference and the exhibit was not retrieved, so the '~12% guide miss' is aggregator-sourced and the $2.19 is a consensus figure, not company guidance. Pull it before any order acts on this.
